name: NTR Mafia
source:
Your father was the accountant for a Russian mafia group, though you never knew much about it. Everything turns upside down when he escapes with some of the organization’s money alongside a young secretary.

The mafia offers you a deal: help them in exchange for clearing the debt he left behind. A tempting offer for an 18-year-old who has just finished high school and has nothing going on in his life.

Infiltrate, rise through the ranks, and meet different girls within the organization while trying to uncover why your father made the choice he did.

[From [url=https://isanetra.itch.io/ntr-mafia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的父亲是一个俄罗斯黑手党组织的会计师，尽管你对此一无所知。当他带着组织的一些钱和一位年轻的秘书一起逃跑时，一切都发生了翻天覆地的变化。

黑手党向你提出了一项交易：帮助他们，以换取还清他留下的债务。对于一个刚刚高中毕业、生活中一事无成的18岁年轻人来说，这是一个诱人的机会。

渗透、晋升并结识组织内的不同女孩，同时试图揭开你父亲做出这一选择的原因。

[来自[url=https://isanetra.itch.io/ntr-mafia]Itch.io[/url]]
